race.comment: VETWELVE (3) is the horse to beat despite a plain eighth at Randwick, as he now eases from metro BM72 company into a BM64 and brings the strongest recent-rating profile in the field. Comes back in trip and assess on his good Rosehill fifth two starts back. Ready to deliver. MIDORI GIANT (4) has the cleaner last-start result, beaten a long neck as favourite at Kembla Grange, and his record around this distance is a clear asset. Likely to go back from the draw and be ridden for luck. COMMANDING ARTIST (1) has had two solid runs this campaign, both in stronger company at this venue. Had no luck last start when fifth in BM68 grade and has genuine winning prospects. MONKHANA (5) has to rebound from two unplaced runs, yet the return of Anna Roper and her strong record aboard the mare keep her in the winning mix at a bigger price. Tongue-tie goes on and must be respected.
